parameters.query: SELECT chat_id, rolling_summary, meta_summary, summary_version, last_summary_at FROM chat_threads WHERE chat_id = $1 LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO chat_threads (chat_id, rolling_summary, meta_summary, summary_version, last_summary_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
ON CONFLICT (chat_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  rolling_summary  = EXCLUDED.rolling_summary,
  meta_summary     = EXCLUDED.meta_summary,
  summary_version  = EXCLUDED.summary_version,
  last_summary_at  = EXCLUDED.last_summary_at
